name: Orpah
title: The Moabite Daughter-in-Law Who Returned
summary: Orpah was a Moabite woman who married Chilion, one of Naomi's sons. After her husband's death, unlike her sister-in-law Ruth, she chose to return to her people and her gods in Moab, which is often contrasted with Ruth's loyalty.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Chilion
keyEvents.description: Orpah married Chilion, the son of Elimelech and Naomi from Bethlehem, while the family was living in Moab during a famine.

keyEvents.title: Death of Her Husband
keyEvents.description: After about ten years in Moab, both Chilion and his brother Mahlon died, leaving Orpah, Ruth, and Naomi as widows.

keyEvents.title: Accompanies Naomi on the Journey
keyEvents.description: When Naomi decided to return to Judah, both Orpah and Ruth accompanied her on the way.

keyEvents.title: Farewell with Naomi
keyEvents.description: After Naomi urged her daughters-in-law to return to their families, Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye and returned to Moab, to her people and her gods.
